pr_title: executor: Fix crash during sort spill
pr_body:
<!--

2. *: what's changed

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #47538

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
1. Add a new interface `SpillHelper` and use a common function `(a *SpillDiskAction) action(t *memory.Tracker, spillHelper SpillHelper)` to unify the code of `(a *SpillDiskAction) Action(t *memory.Tracker)` and `(a *SortAndSpillDiskAction) Action(t *memory.Tracker)`
2. Rename `(c *SortedRowContainer) sortAndSpillToDisk()` to `(c *SortedRowContainer) SpillToDisk()`, hide `Sort()` into `SpillToDisk()`
3. Let `Sort` hold both of `ptrM.Lock()` and `c.m.RLock()`

issue_context.title: Spill in `SortAndSpillDiskAction` may cause TiDB crash if error happens during sort stage
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/937feda20e458ef5468a291f050f0258c653d483/util/chunk/row_container.go#L631-L651

In L648, it use `go a.c.sortAndSpillToDisk() ` to start a spill without setting recover function, and in `sortAndSpillToDisk()`

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/937feda20e458ef5468a291f050f0258c653d483/util/chunk/row_container.go#L563-L566

It will first sort the data, then spill it to disk, `SpillToDisk()` has set recover function, but `Sort()` does not set recover function, so if error happens during `Sort()`, TiDB will crash.

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
